name: dsh-vrchat
description: VRChat creator toolkit for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a 414-page VRChat knowledge base with proactive red-line injection, 9 purpose-built tools, and 6 bundled skills. Covers Udon/UdonSharp, networking and Persistence, Avatar/PhysBone, Shader pipelines and Quest limits; can test whether an API is exposed in Udon, lint generated C#/Shader against hard constraints, inspect the local Unity install and license, scaffold a new World or Avatar project, and drive VPM packages through vrc-get. Injects nothing unless the vrchat preset is selected. / VRChat 创作者工具链：414 页知识库 + 红线主动注入 + 9 个专用工具 + 6 个随包技能。覆盖 Udon/UdonSharp、网络同步与 Persistence、Avatar/PhysBone、Shader 管线与 Quest 限制；能查 Udon API 是否暴露、扫描生成代码的硬约束违例、检查本机 Unity 与许可证、从零创建 World/Avatar 工程、并通过 vrc-get 管理 VPM 包。未选用 vrchat 预设时不注入任何文本。
